title: There’s one psychological trigger that flips the entire sales game — ...
description: There’s one psychological trigger that flips the entire sales game — and it’s the moment clients feel like they need to qualify for you. When I started using this, prospects stopped asking “Why should I hire you?” ...and started asking, “What do I need to do to work with you?” That tiny shift sparks real reactance. People go into overdrive trying to prove they’re a fit. And that’s when inbound demand kicks in. 🚀 Learn the exact system I use to attract clients & grow online—free course in bio. #marketing #entrepreneur #businessgrowth #digitalmarketingtips #smallbusinessowner #clientattraction #salespsychology #businessmindset #highlevelsoftware
transcript: There's one psychological trigger that completely flips the sales game. So instead of chasing clients, they start chasing you. When I started using this trigger, prospects started saying things like, what do I need to do to work with you? No chasing, no awkward follow UPS, just inbound demand. Real psychological reactance happens when you make people feel like they need to qualify to work with you. You're creating real selectivity around who you choose to work with. And the moment someone feels like they might not qualify, like they might not be good enough for you, well, their brain kicks into overdrive trying to prove that they are. When someone perceives themselves as being evaluated or judged, they automatically shift from do I want this to am I good enough for this? And that simple shift, well, it changes everything because now they're trying to convince you instead of you trying to convince them.
